mode.label: Catalog
mode.description: Arrange frames into a print brochure: order, options, checks and PDF.

toolbar.selectPagesHint: Click pages to see them; they don't move here.
toolbar.pickFramesHint: Tick the frames the brochure prints.
toolbar.arrangeHint: Lay the pages out on one line by spread, with their options as the brochure's Arrange setting says (below them while it's off).
toolbar.exportPdfHint: The whole brochure as one PDF.

empty.title: No pages yet
empty.hint: Pick the frames this brochure prints. They go in the order you read the canvas: rows, left to right.
empty.orBlank: Or start with a blank page:

tab.noBrochureHint: A brochure prints this page's frames in the order you choose. A page can hold several, e.g. one per season or language.

images.title: Images
images.hint: Replace keeps the layer, its size and how the picture fills it.

checks.title: Checks
checks.hidden: The page is hidden, so it prints blank.
checks.placeholder: “{name}” is a placeholder: replace it with the picture.

layout.reasonBack: so the back cover is on the left
layout.reasonSpread: so the spread starts on a left page
layout.blank: A blank page goes before it {reason}.
layout.oddSize: It's {w} × {h} mm; the pages are {pw} × {ph} mm.

checks.noProfile: CMYK needs your print shop's profile: load it in the Print section.
checks.stopsAtEdge: “{name}” stops at the page edge: run it {bleed} mm past it, so no line shows after cutting.
checks.roundedPage: “{name}” has rounded corners, so it prints without bleed.
checks.tocOverflow: “{name}” doesn't fit its page: its contents run past the bottom margin. Make the text smaller or give it more room.

layout.label: Layout
layout.splitSpreads: Split spreads into pages in the PDF

frames.newPagesHint: New pages go at the end, in reading order (rows, left to right).
frames.greyedHint: Greyed frames stay in the design; they just aren't printed.
frames.addAsOption: Add as an option of page {page}

page.title: Page {page}
page.oneVersion: One version. To compare others, hover a greyed frame on the canvas and add it as an option of page {page}.

pick.title: Picking frames
pick.click: Click frames on the canvas to tick them, or drag a box round a whole row. Pages already in the brochure start ticked.
pick.order: New pages go in reading order (rows top to bottom, left to right); drag them in the list to fine-tune. Esc cancels.

pick.hint: Pick the frames for the brochure: click them, or drag a box round a row.

sidebar.none: This page has no brochure yet. Create one in the Brochure tab, or pick frames.

a4Brochure.label: A4 brochure
a4Brochure.description: Four blank A4 pages, open in the Catalog mode

print.title: Print
print.noProfile: Load your print shop's profile to export in CMYK.

design.fromMaster: From {master}: edit it on the master

section.title: From a master
section.body: This layer comes from {master} in the brochure “{brochure}”. It's locked here so every page stays the same: edit it on the master, or detach it to change it on this page only.

masters.title: Masters
masters.empty: No masters yet. A master is a header and footer designed once and repeated on every page that uses it.
masters.rowHint: Click to see it, double-click to design it
masters.sideBody: Layers you put on this frame appear, locked, on every page that uses {name}. Text can hold {page}, {pages}, {title}, {section} and {date}.
masters.removeHint: Removing it keeps its frames in the design, as ordinary frames.

pageMaster.label: Master
pageMaster.noMasters: Add a master in the Brochure tab to give pages a header and footer.

panel.title: Page items
panel.hintMaster: Click one to add it to this master, or drag it onto a page or a master.
panel.hintPage: Click one to add it to this page, or drag it onto a page or a master.
panel.dropHere: Drop on a page or a master
